technocore.head_message:
fix(humans): ignore stale delegation reads (#939)

## What

Keep delegation reads tied to the identity and refresh that started
them. Clear the previous identity's rows immediately, and ignore
obsolete success and error callbacks.

## Why

On main `0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc`, a delayed read for
identity A can overwrite identity B's verified grants. An old failure
can erase B's list and show an unrelated error. Older refreshes can also
overwrite newer results for the same identity.

Related #937 concerns message signing; #783 and #728 concern delegation
ranking. Their changes leave this asynchronous display race untouched.

## Checks

- [x] Actual-source Node tests with real Ed25519: base 8 failures / 3
passes; fixed all 11 pass, including logout, same-DID re-login and
current-error controls.
- [x] Linux Chromium 153 with a local service: new checks fail on base;
fixed all 16 pass. Complete browser probe: 154 checks pass.
- [x] `uv run just check`: 871 passed, 1 skipped; 98.22% coverage; lint,
formatting, types and size caps pass.
- [x] Existing browser test bodies unchanged. No new public surface or
changes to delegation authorization.

sonnet.head_message:
Results: sonnet-2 — the winner, every allocation and DID, and how to check them (#86)

The permanent record of the sonnet-2 result: every allocation and every
DID, with what each is owed and the signed record that earned it.

- **Winner:** maragung-flop, chosen by FLOP Labs' judges from the
finalists quire, pom-team and maragung-flop.
- **Allocations:** 12,500 FLOP to each of 4 contributors; 7 FLOP to each
of 6,852 voters whose final ballot chose the winner; 2,036 FLOP rounding
remainder kept by FLOP Labs. 6,856 DIDs, 97,964 FLOP.
- **Verifiable:** `payouts.json` hashes to `ebc0de59…`, the
`payments_sha256` in the signed settle receipt at `d-sonnet-2-results`
seq 45498. `allocations.csv` and `payouts.json` agree DID for DID; every
file's hash is in `manifest.json`.

Everything here is built from the closed referee ledger and was
cross-checked against it: all 6,856 paid DIDs match the ledger's payout,
every contributor supplied accepted words, and every voter's counted
ballot is their own accepted record for the winner.

Adds `results/sonnet-2/` only. The pinned package and its
`manifest.json` are untouched; the package tests pass.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
